messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: eu-west GPU capacity shortage. Autoscaler dropped 2 pods, fallback to smaller model pool applied. Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/2415004321

dev-oncall: We're on the bridge. Observed sustained OOMs on the p3-like pool, autoscaler oscillating. Fallbacks applied to rtx-serve cluster. Confirming customer-facing errors now.

alice: Seeing increased 503s in the API gateway logs for a subset of tenants. Triage: 1) which customers hit, 2) duration, 3) if embeddings impacted.

ben: Quick snapshot: only the large-batch endpoints hit >90th percentile latency. Small gen endpoints ok. Patch applied to route heavy requests to deduped queue.

carla: Customer impact: 4 customers reported elevated errors (support tickets created). No SLA breach yet but user experience degraded. Notifying CSMs.

dev-oncall: Doing live mitigation: 1) increased fallback to smaller model variants, 2) raised autoscaler max temporarily, 3) drained one eviction-prone node. Commands used: ```kubectl cordon node-gpu-12 && kubectl drain node-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets```

alice: Confirmed fallback reduced error rate from 15% -> 3% over 7 mins. Still seeing queue backlog; working on draining cache hotspots.

sre-lead: Good work. Create a JIRA for remediation and postmortem. Capture these action items now. I'll take owner for scaling policy review.

product-ops: Logged customer impact: ENG-6721 created to track customer comms and refunds if needed. Link: https://jira.redwood/ENG-6721

ben: Action items I noted: - investigate autoscaler oscillation thresholds (owner: sre-lead) - add preemptive capacity check in the capacity-runbook (owner: alice) - cross-region spillover test to validate fallback policy (owner: carla)

carla: I'll draft remediation runbook steps and required config flags. ETA for initial doc: EOD tomorrow.

dev-oncall: Postmortem meeting: propose 2415008000 (UTC) for 30m review, invite SRE, Runtime, Product, Support. Who's ok?

alice: +1 for the slot. Please include the logs snippet for the autoscaler: ```[autoscaler] scaleDownCandidates: 3 -> 1; lastScaleTime: 2026-03-16T09:12:03Z```

sre-lead: I'll write the initial postmortem draft and pin action owners. Adding investigation note on kernel OOM behavior when mixed workloads present.

product-ops: I'll handle customer comms draft and coordinate with CSMs after postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident closed to paging at 2415004370. Routed to follow-up queue. Reminder: add tags [gpu, autoscaler, regional-fallback] and link to ENG-6722 (remediation tracking)

ben: Quick checklist before we close thread: - Confirmed no lingering queue >5m - All customers notified - JIRA tickets created (ENG-6721, ENG-6722) - Postmortem scheduled.

alice: All checked. I'll post a short summary in #incidents after the postmortem draft is ready. :white_check_mark:

carla: Leaving notes in ENG-6722 with steps for a staged rollout of the new fallback policy and test plan.

sre-lead: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: autoscaler tuning (sre-lead), capacity runbook updates (alice), cross-region failover test (carla), customer ops (product-ops). Closing thread. :lock:
